subject: Request for short-term sandbox credits while PO clears
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@mediqhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short-term sandbox credits while PO clears

Hi Kimberly —

Quick note from the procurement side: our purchase order for Redwood Dedicated is signed off by the BU, but corporate procurement is doing an extra compliance pass and says it may slip another 5–7 business days. The product and ML teams urgently need the sandbox for an ongoing evaluation — we’re mid-runner on inference cost testing and can’t finish the last benchmarks without another ~48 hours of steady traffic.

Could Redwood temporarily bump our sandbox credits or provide a short trial-topup so our demos and load tests don’t get interrupted? We’d like to avoid losing momentum; the PO (attached) should clear next week.

Thanks — I can jump on a quick call if that helps.

Olivia Chen
Senior Product Manager, MediQ Health
olivia.chen@mediqhealth.com
(415) 555-0199
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@mediqhealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term sandbox credits while PO clears

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for the heads-up and for sharing the PO preview. We can help keep your evaluation live. I can provision a temporary \"escape-hatch\" credit allocation for 5 business days to cover the benchmark window (we typically do a 72–120 hour top-up depending on the case).

Before I finalize:
- Can you confirm the estimated PO clear date?
- Rough token/usage estimate for the next 72 hours so we size the top-up (an approximate number is fine).

Looping in Camila (CS) and David (Finance ops) to OK the credit and record approval. If finance needs an internal approval note, I can share the SOW draft and usage snapshot.

If you want to move faster, send me one quick screenshot of the failing test or the exact API usage pattern and I’ll scope it to minimize cost impact.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 10:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: short-term sandbox credits while PO clears

Camila / David —

Forwarding Olivia's note. Proposed approach: a 5-day, capped credit of 50k tokens for MediQ Health to keep their pilot live while procurement finishes the compliance pass. We’ll attach the latest SOW draft as the business record.

Why this is time-sensitive: losing the 48–72 hour final run can jeopardize the buy decision; their usage pattern shows sustained token generation (narrow, repeated queries) rather than bursty eval. I recommend we approve but set a hard cap and require Olivia to acknowledge the cap and the expected PO date.

If you’re OK, please reply-all with approval and I’ll send the top-up and the confirmation email to the customer.

Thanks,
Kimberly
